answer: The agent marketplace mesa requires every active identity to lock $100 in escrow for 30 days before it can submit bids, with no shared deposits or early withdrawals. Attackers may use a cipher to conceal coordination and forge thousands of profiles, but each profile still needs its own funded deposit. Running 10,000 identities therefore ties up $1 million for a month, imposing a capital requirement and the opportunity cost of keeping those funds idle.
